energy.title: Energy & power
energy.name: Power producers
energy.label: US utilities
energy.context: Power producers and competitive power suppliers. Generation mix, hedges and retail exposure differ. Utility returns also reflect regulated rate bases.
energy.question: How many contracted megawatts have an enforceable delivery date and a completed grid connection?

power.title: Data centres & servers
power.name: Power and cooling
power.label: US industrials
power.context: Electrical distribution and thermal equipment. Landlords and server assemblers have different economics and sit outside this basket.
power.question: How much of the order book has a deposit, a committed delivery date and secured power at the site?

equipment.title: Chip design & equipment
equipment.name: Wafer fabrication equipment
equipment.label: US-listed semiconductors
equipment.context: Process and inspection equipment suppliers depend on fab investment. Chip design software earns licence revenue and is outside this comparison.
equipment.question: Which tool orders have passed fab qualification, and which can the customer defer?

foundry.title: Foundries
foundry.name: Contract chip manufacturers
foundry.label: US-listed semiconductors
foundry.context: Listed foundries earn wafer revenue. Leading-edge and mature-node exposure differ, so a move concentrated in one manufacturer needs separate interpretation.
foundry.question: Is the customer reserving leading-edge capacity, mature-node wafers or advanced packaging, and how binding is that reservation?

compute.title: Compute silicon
compute.name: GPU designers
compute.label: US-listed semiconductors
compute.context: Two GPU designers with material non-AI businesses. Memory, custom silicon and processor IP have separate economics.
compute.question: Does the customer have a production deployment and repeat accelerator orders after the first cluster?

network.title: Networking & interconnect
network.name: Networking and optical interconnect
network.label: US technology
network.context: Switching, optical transport and connectivity suppliers. Broad US technology is the opportunity-cost benchmark.
network.question: Which optical or switching orders have passed customer qualification, and how much volume rests on one cluster build?

cloud.title: Cloud & neoclouds
cloud.name: Specialist cloud
cloud.label: Hyperscalers
cloud.context: Two specialist providers compared with Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet and Oracle. One issuer changes participation by 50 percentage points.
cloud.question: How much contracted GPU revenue is take-or-pay, and does it cover debt service over the hardware’s economic life?

models.title: Foundation models
models.name: Meta Platforms
models.label: US communication services
models.context: Single-company reference. Meta develops foundation models, but the listed equity also reflects advertising and other businesses. Private model developers have no price series here.
models.question: After inference costs, what gross profit does the model provider retain per paying customer as usage grows?

data.title: Data & AI software
data.name: Data platforms
data.label: US-listed software
data.context: Data platforms span warehousing, operational databases and search. Consumption and subscription revenue mixes differ.
data.question: How much incremental data consumption persists after the initial AI deployment?

security.title: Agent platforms & security
security.name: Cybersecurity platforms
security.label: US-listed software
security.context: Enterprise security platforms proxy the security side of this layer. Their equity returns also reflect established network, endpoint and cloud security spending.
security.question: Is agent security winning a new budget, or being bundled into an existing platform renewal?

payments.title: Commerce & payments
payments.name: Card payment networks
payments.label: US financials
payments.context: Two global card networks provide a read on transaction rails. Consumer spending, cross-border mix and regulation dominate the broader business.
payments.question: Can the company identify repeat agent-initiated transactions and the net fee it retains after network costs?

apps.title: Apps & agents
apps.name: Enterprise workflow platforms
apps.label: US-listed software
apps.context: Two incumbent enterprise platforms distribute agents into existing workflows. Standalone agent economics require customer-level evidence.
apps.question: Which agent pilots converted into paid production, and what margin remains after inference and implementation?

devices.title: Devices & physical AI
devices.name: Edge semiconductor suppliers
devices.label: US-listed semiconductors
devices.context: Chip suppliers to device, automotive and embedded markets. Handset demand, industrial inventories and automotive cycles also drive these shares.
devices.question: What share of design wins has converted into shipments, and how much content value is specifically attributable to on-device inference?
